mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDPC1, indicating strengthening economic demand, boosts consumer and business confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 50% of quarters with positive GDPC1 growth.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5%, signaling a tightening monetary cycle, investors anticipate reduced borrowing capacity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month UNRATE decrease below 3.5% indicates improving labor market conditions, enhancing consumer spending power and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX fails to produce positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances with triggered UNRATE conditions.

mechanism_narrative: Jointly, when INDPRO and HOUST both exhibit 2-month growth rates above their respective 6-month moving averages, supply-side momentum boosts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: both INDPRO and HOUST > 6mo MA after 2mo growth
failure_condition: Rank IC between the joint proxy and SPX returns falls below 0.02 over a 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: RSAFS growth exceeding 5% over 2 months signals increased consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, but only during non-recessionary periods.
failure_condition: SPX returns are not significantly higher (t-test p > 0.05) in triggered non-recessionary periods compared to baseline.

mechanism_narrative: Always, a low FEDFUNDS rate (below 2%) is associated with accommodative monetary policy, supporting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward analysis shows no significant positive relationship (p > 0.05) between low FEDFUNDS and SPX 20-day forward returns.

mechanism_narrative: When PAYEMS experiences a 2-month decline, signaling labor market weakness, and UNRATE simultaneously rises above 4%, investors anticipate economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC between the joint proxy and SPX returns falls below 0.01 over a 1.5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month INDPRO growth rate exceeding 2% indicates robust supply-side activity, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, but only during periods of moderate inflation (CPIAUCSL < 300).
failure_condition: SPX returns in triggered moderate inflation periods are not significantly higher (t-test p > 0.05) than in non-triggered periods.
